==Description==
'''A-258''' is an entity from Interminable Rooms. And can be seen anytime when inside [[Super Epic Mode]].

==Appearance==
'''A-258''' is an elongated cyclops that has a peach-coloured eye, fading into white near the center. Hints of greyish-blue can be found near its pupil, which is shaped like an irregular star (in-game, its color changes into an orange colour because of its orange glow) resembling sharp teeth. '''A-258 '''has a black mouth with bloody, pearly white teeth inside. The two parts are separate images, as in-game, the mouth shakes violently while the eye spins in quick succession.

It also emits an orange glow in-game. It occasionally blasts out black, orange and white rings when present.

==Behaviour==
'''A-258''' will have some black, orange and white rings in the middle of the room warning the player that it's about to spawn. When it spawns it will make a very loud noise for around 14 seconds until making a very loud despawn noise.

==Strategy & Tips==
*When '''A-258''' appears, getting to the next room quickly or hiding is advised, in case any entities spawn. Otherwise, you may not hear their spawn cues over the loud noise.
*If player(s) have chosen to hide in the presence of '''A-258''', they should remain in their hiding spot until it despawns. This is time-consuming, however.
*If player(s) are aware that an entity is coming and encounter '''A-258''', they should hide until it despawns.

== Trivia ==
* '''A-258''' is one of the 2 Interminable Rooms entities in game. The 2nd entity being [[U-5]].
